headline: Sold like hot cakes: first Xiaomi models with petrol engines hit sale (photos)
summary: Xiaomi's first plug-in hybrid models, the Skynomad, have gone on sale. The large crossovers can travel up to 500 km on electric power, according to the report.
why: Xiaomi is a major Chinese consumer electronics maker that has been expanding into electric vehicles, competing with automakers in the world's largest car market.

impacts.name: Xiaomi
impacts.why: The company is launching its first plug-in hybrid vehicles, a new product line.
